info.title: PubCaseFinder API
info.description: The PubCaseFinder API uses a fixed URL syntax that translates a standard set of input parameters into the requested data. To maintain stable and fair access to the service, DBCLS requests that users keep their API usage within the published limits. As a general guideline, users should not exceed 10 requests per minute, 100 requests per hour, or 1,000 requests per day. Large-scale or computationally intensive jobs should be scheduled on weekends or during off-peak hours (11:00 PM to 5:00 AM JST on weekdays). DBCLS may apply access controls or rate limits to protect service availability.
